subject: poppy
name: 虞美人
label: 舒展的虞美人
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One open poppy flower viewed slightly from the side, four large crinkled petals expressed through broad edge curves, a clear seed center and one nodding bud.
Keep the flower center as a single simple outlined oval with just THREE sparse curved marks, NOT a cluster of small seeds or circles. No gray leaf fill, no gradients, no shading. At most one gentle interior contour per petal. Place the complete subject inside the central 76% of the square, leaving at least 12% clear margin on all four sides. Plain pure white background. Only clean dark outlines and open white interiors.
